nodes.name: inspector-editor.js
nodes.summary: Implements the inspector's DOM editor CRUD operations (insert/update/delete elements, attribute edits) exposed on window.__ORGII_*, backed by an undo/redo mutation-history stack shared with the other inspector modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Depends on globals defined in inspector-core.js, inspector-element-info.js, and inspector-dom-tree.js per its header comment; its CRUD entry points are anonymous functions assigned to window.__ORGII_* so the extractor only picked up the top-level recordMutation helper.

nodes.name: inspector-element-info.js
nodes.summary: Extracts detailed element metadata (bounding rect, computed style, a curated allowlist of attributes) for display in the inspector's element-info panel.

nodes.name: getElementInfo
nodes.summary: Builds a detailed info object (bounding rect, computed style, key attributes such as id/class/href/aria-label) for a given DOM element, used to populate the inspector's element-info panel.

nodes.name: inspector-mode.js
nodes.summary: Implements enable/disable/toggle of the page's inspect mode, wiring capture-phase listeners for mouse/keyboard events and blocking default browser actions (context menu, drag-start, submit, etc.) while active.

nodes.name: inspector-multi-select.js
nodes.summary: Manages multi-element selection for the inspector — creating, positioning, and tracking bounding-box overlays for every simultaneously selected element.
nodes.languageNotes: Depends on recordMutation from inspector-editor.js per its header comment, extending the shared undo/redo history to multi-select operations.

nodes.name: createMultiSelectOverlay
nodes.summary: Creates and appends a purple bounding-box overlay div used to visually mark one multi-selected element.

nodes.name: inspector-source-loc.js
nodes.summary: Detects the original source-code location (file/line/component) of a DOM element via multiple strategies — code-inspector data attributes, React Fiber internals, styled-components, Vue, and Svelte component metadata — powering "jump to source" in the inspector.

nodes.name: getSourceLocation
nodes.summary: Orchestrates source-location detection for an element by trying each detection method (data-insp-path, debug attributes, React fiber, styled-components, Vue, Svelte) in priority order.

nodes.name: getDebugAttributeSource
nodes.summary: Reads framework-agnostic debug data attributes on an element to resolve its source file/line when present.

nodes.name: getReactFiberSource
nodes.summary: Walks a DOM element's React Fiber tree to recover the owning component's original source file, line, and component name.

nodes.name: tryExtractSourceFromFunction
nodes.summary: Parses a component function's toString output as a fallback to locate its source when Fiber debug info is unavailable.

nodes.name: getStyledComponentSource
nodes.summary: Extracts source-location metadata injected by styled-components' babel plugin.

nodes.name: getVueComponentSource
nodes.summary: Recovers source-location metadata from a Vue component instance attached to the element.

nodes.name: getSvelteComponentSource
nodes.summary: Recovers source-location metadata from a Svelte component instance attached to the element.

nodes.name: page_agent.js
nodes.summary: Injected page-automation agent exposing window.__PAGE_AGENT__: extracts interactive DOM elements with highlight labels, dispatches synthetic click/input/scroll events, and shows a user-takeover mask to block interaction during automated runs in Tauri inline webviews.
nodes.languageNotes: Wrapped in a single IIFE with a double-initialization guard (`if (window.__PAGE_AGENT__) return;`), so all its internals are function-scoped and invisible to the tree-sitter top-level function extractor.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the container crate: local Docker container inspection and lifecycle Tauri commands (via bollard) for the Launchpad feature, depending on app_platform.

nodes.name: types_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying that every known Docker container-state string is mapped correctly to the crate's internal container-state type.

nodes.name: maps_known_container_states
nodes.summary: Asserts that each known Docker container-state string parses to the expected internal state value.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for the database leaf crate: SQLite connection plumbing (rusqlite, WAL mode, PRAGMA tuning) with a registration-based schema-init dispatcher; intentionally has zero Tauri dependency.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documents the database crate's shared SQLite connection pool (WAL mode, PRAGMA tuning) and its registration-based schema-initialization dispatcher, listing the ten-plus consumer modules and the ordered list of domain table initializers that `app::run()` invokes at startup.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for db_browser: ~12 Tauri commands for opening and querying arbitrary SQLite files from the WorkStation code-editor panel, replacing the older WASM sql.js frontend layer.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo manifest for db_clients: remote PostgreSQL/MySQL client Tauri commands (connect/query/execute/list tables) via sqlx, split into its own crate with postgres/mysql cargo features so sqlx's compile-heavy driver stack (top-15 fattest crates in the workspace) doesn't get pulled into the main app build.
